data.name: Spoko and Poko
data.detailed_description:
Drop in to the world of two friendly beetles: relaxed Spoko and angry friend Poko. They need your help to transport a ball to their cottage. Are you ready to help them? Remember to collect all diamonds on the way!
In this arcade game, you can surf in search of diamonds


By manipulating the angry Poko beetle, bounce the ball using the cart
You will encounter many obstacles on the way; we make you familiar with selected ones:
Initial levels consist mainly of racing in search of diamonds and gold
Then you are moved into the world of the Galactic defenders in the good old arcade style
Levels above 15 consist mainly of pinball
Levels above 20 consist of cosmic black holes with eyes of aliens
Levels above 25 consist of arkanoid with our heroes in the lead
On the levels above 27, you will have to fight against angry birds, which will try to take the ball away from our beetles, avoid them! Pink birds will give you diamonds and only those should be smashed
On the levels above 30, you will find UFO flying with aliens
On the levels above 34, you will lead a battle against the alien force
On the levels above 38, you will find a mine, whose tracks lead to a golden temple
In the gold rush, everything is possible, so watch out for jumping carts
On the levels above 40, there are colored candies, which replicate upon touching the ball making the game more difficult
Collect all the candies to get a bonus
Help the beetles to find a road home, which is located at their farm
Moreover, we can hear funny talking beetles in the game.

reviews.review:
Spoko and Poko is a lighthearted arcade adventure developed and published by Volens Nolens Games that embraces an old-school design philosophy while adding its own eccentric personality. The game follows two beetle companions, the sensible Spoko and the impulsive Poko, on a seemingly simple mission to transport a ball back home. What begins as a straightforward treasure-collecting journey quickly evolves into a surprisingly varied experience filled with changing mechanics, unusual obstacles, and a constant stream of new ideas. Rather than focusing on a single gameplay loop, the title continually reinvents itself throughout the adventure.

The central gameplay revolves around controlling the ball, gathering diamonds and gold, and navigating increasingly challenging environments. Early levels serve as an introduction to the game's physics-based mechanics, allowing players to become familiar with movement and collection objectives. These opening stages are easy to understand, but they only represent a small portion of what the game eventually offers. As players progress, the mechanics become more complex, requiring faster reactions and better control to overcome hazards and maximize rewards.

One of the game's strongest qualities is its remarkable variety. The developers clearly drew inspiration from several classic arcade genres and blended them into a single package. Certain levels resemble traditional space shooters, while others introduce pinball-like gameplay elements. Later areas move into cosmic settings featuring UFOs, black holes, and alien-themed challenges. Brick-breaking mechanics, bouncing carts, and unusual environmental interactions further diversify the experience. This constant evolution prevents the adventure from becoming repetitive and gives each new stage a sense of discovery.

The campaign continuously introduces fresh obstacles and objectives. Birds attempt to steal the ball, forcing players to react quickly, while special friendly birds provide opportunities to earn additional diamonds. Mining sections, mysterious temples, alien invasions, and candy-filled levels add further complexity. Some candies multiply when touched, creating chaotic scenarios that require careful planning and quick reflexes. These additions keep players engaged by ensuring that new challenges regularly appear just as they become comfortable with previous mechanics.

Visually, Spoko and Poko embraces a colorful cartoon style that complements its whimsical concept. The beetle protagonists are charming and memorable, while the environments maintain a playful atmosphere throughout the adventure. Although the graphics are relatively simple by modern standards, they effectively support the game's cheerful tone. The changing locations help maintain visual interest, taking players from treasure-filled landscapes to strange cosmic realms without losing the game's distinct identity.

The soundtrack and overall presentation reinforce the arcade-inspired nature of the experience. The game focuses less on narrative depth and more on delivering entertaining gameplay scenarios. This approach works well because the adventure thrives on variety and experimentation rather than storytelling. Players who enjoy classic arcade challenges and score-chasing mechanics will likely appreciate the straightforward design philosophy behind the game.

The biggest weakness of Spoko and Poko is that its abundance of ideas occasionally leads to uneven pacing. Some mechanics feel more refined than others, and certain sections can be significantly more challenging than the levels surrounding them. The physics-based gameplay can also produce moments of frustration when precision is required. Nevertheless, these issues are relatively minor compared to the creativity on display throughout the adventure.

Overall, Spoko and Poko is an imaginative indie arcade game that succeeds through its willingness to constantly surprise players. Its unusual premise, diverse gameplay systems, and retro-inspired design create an experience that feels both nostalgic and distinct. While it may not possess the polish of larger productions, its charm, creativity, and dedication to variety make it an enjoyable choice for players seeking a unique arcade adventure.

Rating: 6/10
